text:
Alex W: Heads-up — planning to run the users.profile_id schema change + backfill tomorrow 2026-03-19 23:00 UTC. Expect a short dual-write shim, then async backfill. Need smoke owner and rollback owner. See timeline below.
Jordan: How long is the maintenance window? any expected table locks?
Alex W: Primary window ~45min for the migration + 1hr dual-write overlap; backfill runs async and is expected ~2h but continues after window. No global locks expected, just targeted CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY + small column add (non-blocking).
Sana: I can own smoke checks and post-deploy verification. What are the critical verifications you want?
Mike R: I can own rollback and the db scripts. Please share the minimal rollback steps and the runbook link.
Alex W: Runbook snippet:```bash
# prepare
pg_dump -s -t users --schema-only > users_schema_before.sql
# migrate
psql -d prod -c "ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN profile_id uuid DEFAULT NULL"
# index (concurrent)
psql -d prod -c "CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_users_profile_id ON users(profile_id)"
# dual-write shim toggle (service flag)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" https://flags.internal/dualwrite/users?enable=true
# backfill (k8s job)
kubectl -n jobs run backfill-users --image=redwood/backfill:stable --command -- /app/backfill --table users --col profile_id
```
Alex W: Runbook full link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/users-profileid-migration (steps + rollbacks + checklist).
deploy-bot: migration-scheduler: Scheduled migration "users.profile_id" for 2026-03-19T23:00:00Z in calendar infra-deploys.
Jordan: Any read-only mode or client migrations needed? mobile/web teams need heads up.
Alex W: No full read-only. We will enable a dual-write shim in service code so writes go to both old and new pipeline (shim lives behind feature flag). Client teams: no action required, but expect a small spike in write latency during shim enablement.
Sana: Metrics I'll watch during smoke: 1) error-rate (5xx) for write endpoints, 2) p99/p50 latencies, 3) DB replication lag, 4) backfill progress (rows/sec). Grafana boards: infra/db-overview, infra/db-replication, infra/backfill-progress.
Mike R: Rollback commands:```bash
# disable dual-write shim
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/dualwrite/users?enable=false -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"
# drop column if needed (safe only if backfill not partially applied to prod)
psql -d prod -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS profile_id"
# revert index
psql -d prod -c "DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_users_profile_id"
```
Mike R: Escalation contacts: Alex W (owner), Jordan (on-call infra), Priya (DB lead). Add pager if high replication lag > 60s.
Jordan: I can be on standby 22:30-01:30 UTC for the window.
Sana: LGTM — I'll run smoke checklist and post the verification matrix to the thread when done. :thumbsup:
Alex W: Thanks — owners: Smoke=Sana, Rollback/Migrations=Mike R, On-call standby=Jordan. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you acknowledge. I'll post the final preflight 1h before.
